review_candidates.description: Engineer Resilience, Strengthen Trust Are you an experienced infrastructure and cybersecurity professional who thrives on solving complex challenges and building secure, resilient technology environments? As our Senior Infrastructure & Cybersecurity Engineer, you will serve as Credit Union of Denver's senior technical authority for infrastructure and cybersecurity. You will shape architecture and standards, own critical platforms, lead high-impact initiatives and incident response, and help ensure the systems our employees and members rely on remain secure, resilient, and operational. A Day In the Life of a Senior Infrastructure & Cyber Security Engineer at Credit Union of Denver: You will shape infrastructure and cybersecurity architecture, roadmaps, standards, and lifecycle plans; lead Cato Networks and the credit union's cloud networking strategy; and design and optimize network, cloud, Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Azure, identity, endpoint, monitoring, vulnerability, backup, and recovery capabilities. As the senior escalation point, you will lead major incident and outage response, set technical priorities, and mentor developing team members. Why You'll Love This Role You will shape the architecture, standards, and long-term direction of critical infrastructure and cybersecurity environments. Your work will directly strengthen system reliability, cybersecurity, organizational resilience, and the protection of member and organizational information. You will lead significant initiatives from requirements and vendor selection through implementation, stabilization, and operational transition. You will serve as a trusted technical leader by mentoring others, improving engineering practices, and translating technical risk into practical recommendations. Position Details Schedule: Monday-Friday 8 AM-5 PM Hours Per Week: Expected to work minimum 40 hours per week (additional hours may be required to fulfill the responsibilities of the position) Classification: Exempt Salary Range: $122,613- $129,066/annually What We're Looking For A bachelor's degree in information technology, cybersecurity, computer science, information systems, or a related field is preferred. Five to eight years of progressively responsible experience in infrastructure, networking, cybersecurity, cloud engineering, or a related discipline, including ownership of complex environments, technical leadership, and delivery of significant initiatives. Deep knowledge of infrastructure and security architecture, cloud-delivered networking, zero trust, identity, Microsoft security services, incident response, vulnerability management, high availability, disaster recovery, and operational risk. Experience leading complex infrastructure and cybersecurity initiatives, establishing engineering standards, and guiding coordinated responses to high-impact events. The ability to explain technical concepts, risks, and recommendations clearly to executive leadership and non-technical stakeholders, along with strong mentoring and coaching skills. Advanced credentials such as CISSP, CISM, CCNP, Microsoft Cybersecurity Architect, GIAC, vendor SASE or network certifications, or equivalent credentials are preferred. For a complete job description, requirements, and to apply for this position please visit our careers page at: https://cudenver.applicantpro.com/jobs/ Work Perks That Wow Medical Insurance- including a $0 cost plan option, Health Reimbursement Account (HRA), Health Savings Account (HSA). Dental (2 plans to choose from, including orthodontic coverage) and Vision Insurance. Eleven Paid Holidays -The ultimate benefit to working in the banking industry; relax, recharge and celebrate what matters most! Vacation and Sick pay. Bereavement and Jury Duty Leave. Volunteer Time off -Engage in meaningful community outreach and help make a positive impact where you live and work. 401(k) Plan with early enrollment eligibility and generous employer match. Employee Loan Rate Benefit Program. Employee Assistance Program and Employee Wellness Program- we care about your mental and physical wellness! Paid Life, AD&D and Short-Term and Long-Term Disability Insurance. Supplemental Insurance through Unum. Flexible Spending Accounts. Profit Sharing Program and Service Awards- Get rewarded for your service and helping our Credit Union succeed! Educational and Certification Assistance- We believe in investing in your future, we offer educational and certification assistance to help you reach your professional goals and stay ahead in the industry. Early Access to earned wages Employee Discounts – Enjoy discounts on travel, hotels, childcare, groceries and much more, offered through LifeMart. Ample parking at no cost! About Credit Union Of Denver At Credit Union of Denver, we're more than a financial institution, we're a trusted partner in helping our members navigate life's journey. Our commitment to Doing Life With You guides everything we do, from supporting our members' financial well-being to investing in the success of our employees. As we celebrate 95 years of serving our members and communities, we're proud of the lasting relationships we've built through personalized service, trusted guidance, and a commitment to putting people first. We believe our employees are the heart of that mission. That's why we offer opportunities for career growth through our Walk-a-Mile program, Career Pathways, and professional development resources designed to help you build a rewarding career. At Credit Union of Denver, you'll find more than a job, you'll find a collaborative team, meaningful work, and a culture that values learning, service, and community involvement. Whether you're supporting members, volunteering in the community, or advancing your career, we're committed to Doing Life With You every step of the way. Ready to engineer secure, resilient technology that protects member trust and strengthens our future? review_candidates.title: Lead Information Security Engineer
review_candidates.description: As a member of the Information Services Department, the Lead Information Security Engineer is responsible for designing, implementing, and continuously improving security controls that protect the Firm’s networks, applications, endpoints, cloud environments, and data from evolving cyber threats. This role serves as a technical authority on security architecture, partnering with other Information Services teams to evaluate solutions, identify security risks, and ensure new technologies are securely designed and deployed from the ground up. The Lead Information Security Engineer provides technical leadership for key security platforms, resolves complex security challenges, and drives the continuous maturation of the Firm’s overall security architecture, capabilities, and risk management practices. Essential Functions Design, engineer, and implement secure network solutions, cloud environments (Azure), and application security controls. Lead security architecture reviews for new technologies, applications, infrastructure, and cloud services; identify security risks and design gaps and provide technical recommendations to ensure solutions align with the firm’s security standards. Secure Azure resources and IaaS solutions to ensure new deployments meet security standards. Manage and onboard SIEM log sources, ensuring security-relevant logs are available and properly configured for use by the SOC team. Design, implement, and optimize data loss prevention (DLP) policies and secure web gateway (SWG) controls to protect sensitive data. Develop and maintain security standards, technical controls, and configuration guidelines for infrastructure, cloud, applications, and security technologies. Evaluate vulnerabilities and security findings, assess risk and business impact, and collaborate with technical teams to develop and implement appropriate remediation strategies. Provide engineering support during security incidents, including investigation, containment, remediation, and implementation of preventative controls. Evaluate security technologies, vendors, and solutions; participate in proof-of-concept activities and provide technical recommendations for security-related technology investments. Additional Functions Secure infrastructure and server environments, including virtual environments for Windows and Linux servers. Support and advance the organization’s zero trust network access (ZTNA) solution. Support and maintain certificate lifecycle management processes. Assist with securing and maintaining VMware environments. Contribute to identity and access management initiatives, including Azure Entra, LDAP, and SSO integrations. Partner with networking teams on networking security matters and network security architecture. Evaluate the security and privacy implications of AI tools and technologies and support the secure adoption of AI across the firm. Support email security tools, configurations, and related security controls. Participate in security projects and initiatives as assigned. Education QUALIFICATIONS (EXPERIENCE, KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES): Bachelor’s degree in information security or an equivalent combination of work and education required. Experience Minimum of five years of information security experience required including hands-on experience designing, implementing, and maintaining enterprise security technologies and controls. Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities Strong understanding of security architecture and cloud security principles, with hands-on experience securing Azure environments. Proficiency with firewalls and network security controls. Experience with SIEM tools, including log source onboarding, configuration, and management. Strong knowledge of identity and access management (IAM) concepts and technologies. Experience with endpoint detection and response (EDR) platforms and endpoint security controls. Familiarity with zero trust network access (ZTNA) architectures and security principles. Experience designing, administering, and optimizing data loss prevention (DLP) and secure web gateway (SWG) policies. Understanding of DNS security concepts and DNS-as-a-Service solutions. Ability to review and assess architecture plans for security risks, design gaps, and compliance with security standards. Experience with vulnerability assessment and remediation processes. Experience with scripting or automation languages such as PowerShell, Python, Bash, or similar. Ability to independently troubleshoot complex technical and security issues and develop effective solutions. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate complex security risks and technical recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Ability to work effectively and collaboratively with infrastructure, networking, cloud, identity, application, and other technical teams. Work Environment & Physical Demands This job operates in a clerical, office setting. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, filing cabinets and fax machines. Physical Requirements Sedentary work: Exertion of physical strength to lift, carry, push, pull, or otherwise move objects up to 10 pounds. Work involves sitting most of the time. Walking and standing is often necessary in carrying out job duties. DISCLAIMER Fox Rothschild LLP is under no obligation to provide sponsorship for this position. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis now and in the future. The above is intended to describe the general content of and requirements for the performance of this job. It is not a contract or employment agreement and is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of all functions, responsibilities, or requirements the employee may be required to perform, and the employee may be required to perform additional duties. Additionally, management reserves the right to review and revise the job description at any time. Employment with the firm is at-will. Employees must be able to satisfactorily perform all the essential functions of the position with or without reasonable accommodation. If an accommodation request would cause an undue hardship or a safety concern, the individual may not be eligible for the position. Fox Rothschild LLP is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, religion, color, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or gender expression, breastfeeding, lactation, disability, or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local jurisdictions.
